description: POM anti-backlash nut, floating and captive under nut_plate. How the bed is lifted: the POM anti-backlash nut z_nut (supplied on the motor's screw; dimensions a STAND-IN) rides lead screw leadscrew. Its square flange is under this 9.525 mm plate, which is bolted under the 2020 square's member sq_rear (two M5 from below into T-nuts) and reaches 56.2 mm out to the screw; the nut's barrel hangs below. The carrier's weight rests on the flange, so when the screw turns the nut climbs it and lifts the plate, the square, the deck and the bed. The M2.5 pin screw nut_pin (through a 5 mm aluminium sleeve, fixed in a corner hole of the flange) sits in a radial slot in the plate: it stops the nut turning with the screw while letting it float 2 mm sideways. The nut is captive: the laser-cut keeper nut_keeper, bolted 0.1 mm under the flange on two M3 through-bolts and spacers, stops the plate lifting off it.
